description: The Split String node takes in a string and a separator, along with options on how you want to handle empty entries. The node then returns a Collection of that string.

fields.String: The provided string used to turn into a collection.
fields.Separator: The string separator used to chop up the provided string for the array.
fields.RemoveEmptyEntries: If true, will remove any empty entries found in the provided string.
fields.TrimEntries: If true, will remove any empty entries found around the start and end of the provided string.
fields.* ([[Type:String|String]]): Returns a collection of the string.
